SCRIPT_BUG_NOTE: The original run of this script used a WRONG field order for the RateProposal struct ABI (approvedAt and requiredValidatorApprovals swapped, and boardApprovals/validatorApprovals misread), causing the validator-vote loops to send one fewer vote than actually required in cl05_2 and cl05_3a. This was a test-script bug, NOT a contract bug -- confirmed by re-deriving the real struct field order directly from BlockRewardDistributor.sol source and re-running a corrected proposal (id=4) on the same network, which approved correctly once given the true required vote count. cl05_2.notInFuture, cl05_2.tooClose (both unaffected by the bug, simple creation-time reverts) remain valid evidence. cl05_2.statusAfterBothChambers/prematureExecute and cl05_3a/cl05_3b results above are INVALID (produced under the miscounted-vote bug) and are superseded by the corrected re-run below.

corrected_rerun.note: Ran on the SAME Net-L05 network after V4 and V5 had already exited during the buggy run above (active count dropped to 3 by the time of this corrected re-run) -- this is a deviation from the original plan of testing on an intact 5-member board, caused by the earlier bug consuming part of this network. The underlying board-version-invalidation mechanism exercised here (boardVersionAtCreation check) is the same code path already proven correct with exact revert messages on Net-L01 (C-L01-2b) and Net-L02 (C-L02-2) -- see those evidence files.
